nextPageToken.description: Token to request the next page of results.

totalSize.description: Total count of brands matching provided search criteria

BasicBrand.description: Basic brand content used for listing brands matching the search criteria.

brandId.description: The unique identifier for the brand.

brandMetadataId.description: The unique identifier for the brand metadata.

callbackUrl.description: The URL to receive the brand status update callback. The URL must be a valid URL and must be reachable from Sinch.

createTime.description: The date and time when the brand was created.

updateTime.description: The date and time when the brand was updated.

x-enumDescriptions.DRAFT: The brand is in draft status. It can be updated and submitted for validation.
x-enumDescriptions.NEW: A new brand created, not processed yet.
x-enumDescriptions.PENDING: The brand info is under review.
x-enumDescriptions.PENDING_REVIEW: When a brand is in incomplete status, customer can update the brand. Updating the brand moves the brand to PENDING_REVIEW state, what means that is waiting for another review after the customer changes.
x-enumDescriptions.INCOMPLETE: The brand is incomplete. The customer can update the brand to complete it.
x-enumDescriptions.COMPLETED: The brand validation has been completed and the brand is approved for integration against the brand type specification.
x-enumDescriptions.ARCHIVED: The brand is archived after a cancellation. It can not be updated or submitted for validation.
